Date: Fri May 22 18:10:00 CEST 2026
Subject: [libcamera-devel] libcamera v0.8.0 released

libcamera v0.8.0 has been released.
This release updates SoftISP behavior, image pipeline handling, and sensor mode configuration.
It also improves V4L2 camera pipeline validation for media controller devices.
The Mali-C55 pipeline handler now has full support for inline handling and camera support.
